question: Name the event with the highest amount spent on advertisement.
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "event_member_expenses" AS SELECT
  t1.event_id,
  t1.event_name,
  t1.event_date,
  t3.link_to_member AS member_id,
  t4.expense_id,
  t4.expense_description,
  t4.expense_date,
  t4.cost,
  t4.approved
FROM table_1 AS t1
JOIN table_3 AS t3
  ON t3.link_to_event = t1.event_id
JOIN table_4 AS t4
  ON t4.link_to_member = t3.link_to_member

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH parsed AS (
  SELECT
    event_id,
    event_name,
    CAST(strptime(event_date, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S') AS DATE) AS event_dt,
    member_id,
    expense_id,
    expense_description,
    CAST(expense_date AS DATE) AS expense_dt,
    cost,
    approved
  FROM event_member_expenses
),
ads AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM parsed
  WHERE expense_description IS NOT NULL AND (
    expense_description ILIKE '%poster%' OR
    expense_description ILIKE '%flyer%' OR
    expense_description ILIKE '%print%' OR
    expense_description ILIKE '%ad%' OR
    expense_description ILIKE '%advert%' OR
    expense_description ILIKE '%marketing%' OR
    expense_description ILIKE '%banner%' OR
    expense_description ILIKE '%sign%' OR
    expense_description ILIKE '%facebook%' OR
    expense_description ILIKE '%instagram%' OR
    expense_description ILIKE '%social%' OR
    expense_description ILIKE '%promo%' OR
    expense_description ILIKE '%promotion%'
  )
),
windowed AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM ads
  WHERE expense_dt >= event_dt - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND expense_dt <= event_dt
),
by_event AS (
  SELECT event_id, event_name, SUM(cost) AS total_ad_spend
  FROM windowed
  GROUP BY event_id, event_name
)
SELECT event_name, event_id, total_ad_spend
FROM by_event
ORDER BY total_ad_spend DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;
